title: TAXNMY referee verdict
description: The answer of the AI referee on one proposal, for rules TR4-TR8. The outcome (accept, reject, alias, human) is computed from it by code; see referee/prompt.md.

duplicate_of.description: The key of the existing product this proposal duplicates (TR4), or null.

own_product.description: TR4: a judgment with, for yes, a version of the product quoted from its versions source.

evidence.description: For yes and no: the quotes that support the answer, each copied exactly from a source text. Empty for doubt, and empty when the system prompt asks for no evidence.

version.description: A version of the product that a customer sees or chooses (a number, a build or the name of a release), copied exactly from the text of the versions source (versions.source). Null when that text shows none; TR4 is then not yes.

evidence.description: For yes and no: the quotes that support the answer, each copied exactly from a source text. Empty for doubt, and empty when the system prompt asks for no evidence.
